scenarios.name: Show the location of a saved document in its tab preview

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the second part has been saved to a file
the user hovers over the second part's document tab
a thumbnail of the second part appears above the tab
the preview label displays the saved file's full path and part name on separate lines
